title: Agents
description: Connect a global agent to your coursework through VStudy. You choose its accounts and permissions. Every write needs your approval.
master_help: Off until you turn it on. Turning it off stops calls and cancels pending requests.
offline: VStudy could not refresh agent connections. Approvals are unavailable until it reconnects.
action_error: The action could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the latest state.
no_grants: No paired agents yet. Connect an agent, then approve its request in VStudy.
scope_write_moodle-high: Propose school drafts and forum posts
no_accounts: Connect a school in Courses before granting access.
selection_hint: Select at least one permission and one account. Newly connected accounts are never added automatically.
edit_help: Changes apply to this agent only. Every write still needs separate approval.
future_expiry: Choose an expiry in the future.
activity_help: Calls are recorded locally for 30 days. Arguments shown here are redacted by VStudy.
connect_help: Install Node.js 24.11.1 or later on this computer, then copy a setup command or preview the configuration change. Installation never grants school access.
no_clients: No client configurations are available. Refresh to check again.
copy_error: Could not copy the command. Select and copy the text below.
clients_error: Could not load client configurations. Try again.
preview_help: Review this diff before installing. Your existing settings are preserved and backed up.
no_change: The configuration is already up to date.
installed: Configuration installed. Start your agent and compare its pairing code in VStudy.
install_error: Could not change the configuration. Preview it again before retrying.
doctor_error: Could not run connection checks. Try again.
self_reported: Client names are self-reported. A name does not prove identity.
pair_help: Compare this short code with the code shown by the agent you are connecting. A matching code helps you approve the right pending request.
code_confirm: I compared both codes and they match.
pair_expiry: Access expires after 30 days. You can change or revoke it in Settings > Agents.
proposal_help: This approves this exact action once. No response within 60 seconds means denial. Assignment final submission is always manual in Moodle.
high_risk: Forum replies may be published or graded. Assignment text is saved only as a draft. Final submission is always manual in Moodle.
request_expired: This request has expired. It cannot be approved.
decision_uncertain: This decision was sent once and cannot be sent again here. Check Activity for its result.
own_work: I confirm this is my own work and I want to save this exact text as a draft.
unavailable: Agent access is unavailable on this platform/build
